messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (duplicate) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is the core problem still open, not solved by a shipped story and not covered by a roadmap item? Pass means yes.
Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.
The evidence is the problem statement and the five most similar stories and roadmap pages, with status and dates.
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "problem_statement": "Teams are overwhelmed by manual tasks like document routing, letter generation, and invoice handling, with no clear tracking or visibility into stuck items. This leads to delays, lost time, and unacknowledged communications that harm efficiency and policyholder trust.",
 "similar": [
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4132",
   "similarity": 0.031,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": true, \"completed_at\": \"2026-09-15T00:00:00Z\", \"description\": \"Keelwater now displays a chronological activity timeline for each claim, showing key events, user actions, and system updates in a clear, scrollable interface to improve case tracking and accountability.\", \"id\": 4132, \"name\": \"Activity timeline display\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 3}"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4135",
   "similarity": 0.031,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": false, \"completed_at\": null, \"description\": \"Keelwater's claim information display provides a clear, real-time overview of active claims, including status, assigned adjuster, and key dates, helping users stay informed without switching screens.\", \"id\": 4135, \"name\": \"Claim information display\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 2}"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4134",
   "similarity": 0.03,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": false, \"completed_at\": null, \"description\": \"Keelwater is enhancing its task list interface to improve user efficiency, allowing for better prioritization, drag-and-drop reordering, and real-time status updates—all designed to streamline claims processing workflows.\", \"id\": 4134, \"name\": \"Task list improvements\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 2}"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4133",
   "similarity": 0.03,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": false, \"completed_at\": null, \"description\": \"Keelwater's document classifier confidence threshold setting allows users to define the minimum confidence level required for automatic categorization of claims documents, ensuring only high-certainty classifications are applied without manual review.\", \"id\": 4133, \"name\": \"Document classifier confidence threshold\", \"started\": false, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 1}"
  },
  {
   "source": "notion",
   "id": "30cf8382-0725-5e19-b883-945ae35bebcd",
   "similarity": 0.029,
   "record": "{\"id\": \"30cf8382-0725-5e19-b883-945ae35bebcd\", \"object\": \"page\", \"properties\": {\"Name\": {\"title\": [{\"plain_text\": \"Supplier directory\", \"text\": {\"content\": \"Supplier directory\"}, \"type\": \"text\"}], \"type\": \"title\"}, \"Problem\": {\"rich_text\": [{\"plain_text\": \"A searchable directory within Keelwater that lets users find and manage supplier information, including contact details, contract status, and claim history, streamlining collaboration and compliance tracking.\", \"text\": {\"content\": \"A searchable directory within Keelwater that lets users find and manage supplier information, including contact details, contract status, and claim history, streamlining collaboration and compliance tracking.\"},"
  }
 ]
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "I checked the problem statement about teams being overwhelmed by manual document routing, letter generation, invoice handling, and lack of visibility into stuck items against the five most similar stories and roadmap pages. All similarities are very low (~0.03), and no item matches the core problem: story 4132 (completed activity timeline) improves case tracking but does not address manual task automation or invoice handling; 4135 (claim info display) and 4134 (task list improvements) are in progress and do not cover routing or invoice handling; 4133 is an unstarted classifier threshold setting; and the Notion page is a supplier directory, unrelated. No shipped story or roadmap item solves this problem.", "verdict": "pass"}
